threshold_source: No epic-specific NFR thresholds exist; CI defines a five-minute lint timeout.

performance.evidence: tools/run-c-lint.sh completed in 25.82 seconds locally, below the 300-second CI timeout.

reliability.evidence: tests/test-c-lint.sh passed missing-tool, baseline, source-scope, and new-diagnostic cases.

operability.evidence: The runner reports its Cppcheck version, preserves analyzer diagnostics, and emits an actionable missing-package message.
